behaviour.wander.description: Walk to random reachable points within a radius.

behaviour.greet.description: Says a line to someone who comes close (looking at them), then waits a while before greeting again.

clip.description: A voice line (.wav) with its timings beside it.

text.description: The caption (or the line, without a clip).

behaviour.switchedBy.description: Shown while an item is in a state (a lamp lit while its switch is on), hidden otherwise.

behaviour.hinge.description: A door hinge: a revolute joint with limits and a motor.

behaviour.noticeViewer.description: Sees the person at the camera (@vrmxg/sense): looks at them when they appear and away when they leave, answers a wave and a nod with animation slots, and can say lines. Needs the sense service and the scene's viewer node.

answers.description: Camera event (wave, nod, shake, point) → the animation slot that answers it.

say.description: Camera event (appeared, wave, nod, shake, point) → a line to say.

smile.description: The expression shown when someone appears.

behaviour.brain.description: An NPC brain: perception, memory, a behaviour tree with utility choices, and the action vocabulary. A role preset (server, customer, wanderer; host, conversationPartner, follower, which a director can talk with; actor, who does only what she is directed to), a brain document in the project (brains/hana.json) or a preset object; vars override its blackboard plan.

preset.description: A role preset, a brain document's path, or a preset object ({ plan, senses, tree }).

vars.description: Blackboard values over the preset's plan.

tickEvery.description: Think every n steps (four times slower far from the player).
